action_summary: Repairs a defect that eliminated capabilities before they could be selected. world_probe_v1._kinds_of matched file kinds with a raw substring test, and kind_contradiction turns that into an ELIMINATION, not a down-rank. Measured on the live 145-capability registry: 8 capability ids announce a kind nobody declared -- all six chart.raster.* declare 'ast' by the accident 'ch-art.r-ast-er' while their own rows say requires: ['image.file.available'], plus 'ub-json' -> json and 'ks-tar' -> tar. On 8 capabilities each given a real file of the right kind, 7/8 were eliminated before selection with INPUT_KIND_CONTRADICTS_GOAL_FILE; after the whole-word repair, 0/8 are, and each reaches an honest refusal AFTER selection. Also audits round 3's claim that the 11 blind premises are the highest-gain item: a full 145-capability census gives 59 SELECTED, 54 not-bindable, 12 premise-blocked, so the premises are 8% of the registry and binding is 37%; asserting the premise unblocks only 3 of 10. The round-3 claim is corrected in place rather than deleted.
explicit_user_authorization: Owner directive 2026-11-12: what is wrong, why can't we do this now -- separate what is real from what is not, kill dumb ideas before implementing them, always push and merge the work. Round 4 audits my own round-3 claim before building on it. $0 spend, zero model dependency, no protected path touched; world_probe_v1.py is not on the protected list.

recursive_obs.real_outcome: A defect that silently removed eight capabilities from the hypothesis space is removed, and the round-3 work item is re-priced by a census that counts all 145 capabilities rather than the 12 that were being audited.
recursive_obs.required_capability: An input-kind recogniser that reads WHOLE WORDS, because a kind inferred from the middle of a word is not a fact about the capability and must never eliminate one.

obs_capability.surviving_gap: No record binds (capability, observed state, outcome). macro_v1 stores only plans whose every step verified, so the system retains successes and discards exactly the negative examples that could narrow applicability.

obs_blocker.intrinsic_or_path_specific: Intrinsic: with positive-only evidence the conjunction version space keeps the empty requirement alive, so the action is declared applicable in 68% of the states where it fails. This is a property of consistency, not of any implementation.

BYPASS identification by trusting the declared requires: rejected, the 11 blind premises show it cannot always be decided
SUBSTITUTE a richer grammar for evidence: rejected here, it changes the prior not the evidence class

obs_obs.search_stop_decision: Stopped at three candidate mechanisms because the remaining ones were measured already: breadth of environments (0/10), exposure per lesson (6/7 flat), and model-in-producer-path (forbidden).

recursive_obs.why_selected_route_is_fastest_sufficient: It is one function with one call site, it is measured at the front door before and after, and it converts an unreachable set into a reachable set. Any cheaper fix would have to be a deletion, and deleting the kind check would admit genuinely contradictory capabilities.

tournament.decisive_question: Does a capability id that contains a file-kind token inside an unrelated word actually declare that kind, and does the accident eliminate a capability that a correctly-kinded file would otherwise reach?
